_comment: Thawed blood (iteration 012). Every Burnt One carries frozen blood in its clothing. Near real warmth it thaws; while thawed it now and then drips, and the drop refreezes into a small crimson mark on snow. Marks fade, wash away in rain and are buried by falling snow. Units: seconds of game time, px. EXPLORING prototype values.

weather._comment: erase: how fast marks disappear (per minute, 1 = gone in a minute); kind: fade (old blood darkens into the snow), wash (rain), cover (falling snow). visibility: how readable marks are; range: px within which a mark can be made out at all.
